name: browser_get_element
title: Get a picked element
description: Look up an element a person picked in the viewer with the Pick tool. They give you a code like "el-3f9a". Returns its ref (usable with browser_click, browser_type…), role, name, text, selector and HTML.

agent.description: Your sub-agent name (e.g. "painter-1"). Agents that share a tab each get their own cursor, refs and snapshots; calls that click, drag or type take turns on the tab

code.description: The code shown in the viewer, e.g. "el-3f9a"

tabId.description: Target tab ID; omitted uses the active tab

name: browser_get_flow
title: Read a recorded flow
description: Read a flow a person recorded in the viewer with the Record button: every click, typed text, choice, key and page change, in order. They give you an id like "flow-3fa9c1", often on its own: whenever a message contains such an id, call this tool with it first. Returns the numbered steps, each with the element's role and name (as in browser_snapshot) plus fallback hints. Replay it with browser_run_flow, or follow the steps yourself to adapt them. Without flowId: lists the recorded flows.

agent.description: Your sub-agent name (e.g. "painter-1"). Agents that share a tab each get their own cursor, refs and snapshots; calls that click, drag or type take turns on the tab

flowId.description: The flow id shown in the viewer, e.g. "flow-3fa9c1"; omit to list all flows

tabId.description: Target tab ID; omitted uses the active tab

name: browser_run_flow
title: Replay a recorded flow
description: Replay a flow a person recorded (see browser_get_flow): opens its start page, then does every step again, finding each element anew on the page. Use repeat to run it several times, and inputs to change what a step types or chooses (by step number). Stops at the first step that fails and says which, so you can finish it yourself.

agent.description: Your sub-agent name (e.g. "painter-1"). Agents that share a tab each get their own cursor, refs and snapshots; calls that click, drag or type take turns on the tab

inputs.description: Text to type or option to choose instead of the recorded one, by step number, e.g. {"3": "new search"}. Required for password steps (passwords are not recorded)

repeat.description: How many times to run the flow (default 1, max 50); each run starts from the start page

skipStart.description: Start from the current page instead of opening the flow's start page

tabId.description: Target tab ID; omitted uses the active tab

Other agents' clicks, drags and typing on this tab wait until you call browser_unlock_tab or the lock expires. Keep it short and always unlock.

name: browser_state
title: Save and restore a session
description: Save the browser's login state (all cookies of every site + localStorage/sessionStorage of every site open in a tab) under a name, and load it later, even after a restart. Use it to keep a login, switch between accounts, or return to a known state. export writes one state (or all of them, if no name) to a single JSON file you can carry to another machine; import reads such a file back (also Cookie-Editor cookie lists and Playwright storageState files) so the sessions can be loaded there without logging in again. Saved and exported files hold secrets: delete states you no longer need.

agent.description: Your sub-agent name (e.g. "painter-1"). Agents that share a tab each get their own cursor, refs and snapshots; calls that click, drag or type take turns on the tab

title: Snapshot diff
description: Show only what changed on the page since an earlier snapshot: since the last one you saw (default), or since a baseline saved with save. Cheaper than reading the whole page again, and good for checking what an action did.

name: browser_emulate
title: Emulate a device
description: Make the browser behave like another device or environment: a phone/tablet preset (screen size, pixel ratio, touch, user agent), or your own width/height/scale/mobile, plus locale, time zone, dark mode, GPS location and network speed. Applies to all tabs; the page reloads when the device changes. device "reset" goes back to desktop; call with no arguments to see the current settings and the device list.

agent.description: Your sub-agent name (e.g. "painter-1"). Agents that share a tab each get their own cursor, refs and snapshots; calls that click, drag or type take turns on the tab

name: browser_read_chat
title: Read the room chat
description: Read messages people wrote to you in the viewer's chat with @agent (people address you by your client name, e.g. @opencode, or @agent for every agent; only new ones since your last read; all=true shows the whole chat). With time (seconds, max 60) it waits for a new message when there is none. Answer with browser_say. Messages may contain picked-element codes like el-3f9a: look them up with browser_get_element; and recorded flow ids like flow-3fa9c1: read them with browser_get_flow.

agent.description: Your sub-agent name (e.g. "painter-1"). Agents that share a tab each get their own cursor, refs and snapshots; calls that click, drag or type take turns on the tab

all.description: Show the whole chat, not only new messages for you

time.description: Seconds to wait for a new message if there is none (default 0, max 60)

name: browser_say
title: Tell the people watching
description: Show a short message to the people watching the browser (a caption on the screen and a line in the room chat). This is also how you reply to a chat message read with browser_read_chat. Use it to explain your plan or to ask them for help, e.g. to log in or solve a captcha.

description: Disconnect from the shared browser when you are done: you leave the room the people watch, give back control and free the tabs you locked. Calling any browser tool later connects you again.
